title: DC's Year of the Villain #1 2019 Collector's Paradise Store Variant Greg Capullo
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
DC's Year of the Villain #1 (July 2019), DC Comics - the 25-cent special that launched the Year of the Villain event, Collector's Paradise retailer edition ("Presented by Collector's Paradise" on the cover). Written by Brian Michael Bendis, Scott Snyder and James Tynion IV. Greg Capullo cover with Perpetua, the Batman Who Laughs, Bane, Lex Luthor and Cheetah; the dark secret of Leviathan.

Back cover: Collector's Paradise store ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
